p: Israel: That is, the ten tribes, which neglected God's benefit in delivering their brethren, and had rather remain in captivity, than to return home when God called them.
cup of trembling to all the: Jerusalem will be defended against all her enemies: so will God defend all Judah also, and will destroy the enemies.

inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my: Every captain, that had many under him before, will now think that the small power of Jerusalem will be sufficient to defend them against all enemies, because the Lord is among them.

tents of Judah first: The people who are now as it were dispersed by the fields, and lie open to their enemies, will be preserved by my power just as if they were under their kings (which is meant by the house of David), or in their defended cities.
grace and of supplications: They will have the feeling of my grace by faith, and know that I have compassion on them.
pierced: That is, whom they have continually vexed with their obstinacy, and grieved my Spirit. In Joh 19:37 it is referred to Christ's body, whereas here it is referred to the Spirit of God.
him: They will turn to God by true repentance, whom before they had so grievously offended by their ingratitude.
mourning of: They will exceedingly lament and repent for their offences against God.
Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon: Which was the name of a town and place near to Megiddo, where Josiah was slain; 2Ch 35:22.
land shall mourn: That is, in all places where the Jews will remain.
apart: Signifying, that this mourning or repentance would not be a vain ceremony: but every one touched with his own griefs will lament.
house of David apart: Under these certain families he includes all the tribes, and shows that both the kings and the priests had by their sins pierced Christ.
remain: That is, who were elect by grace, and preserved from the common destruction.
